2. Application stands disposed of.
3. This is an application seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No. 0106/2021 dated 05.03.2021 u/s 498A/306/34 IPC registered by the brother of the deceased victim, namely Neelam.
4. The deceased victim, Neelam was married to one Mr. Ravinder in December 2006.
After 11 years of marriage, on 05.08.2017, Neelam was found dead by hanging herself from a ceiling fan.

Hence,
the FIR.
5. In the present case, the inquest report is in favour of the applicant.
The application u/s 156 Cr.P.C. filed by the brother for registration of the FIR was dismissed by the learned MM vide order dated 26.04.2018.
